notes.title: Welcome to "Frosty Enterprise"
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45297439/906468d03fb4b04c7e32b1d029c2d3bfbf9dddc8.png[/img]

I would like to announce the name change for the game i've been working on! If you might have seen the name of the was "Ice Cream Vendor Simulator" when Steam page was published. After a bit of brainstorm, i decided a name change for better representation to the community.

After another process of rethinking the name, i decided on "Frosty Enterprise". This version reflects the game better to the community and gives it a fresh look, saving it from generic titles. 

I hope this change makes you happy! 

Thanks!
